attributes.board_name: District of Columbia Board of Occupational Therapy (DC Health)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved programs relevant to OT practice: state/local OT associations, AOTA, APTA, ASHA, ASHT, AOTA-approved providers, accredited healthcare facilities or colleges. Credit also for authoring, teaching/presenting (max 50% of requirement), supervision (max 6 per period), clinical instruction, fieldwork education, publications, board/committee work, research. Excluded: mandatory non-clinical in-service (BLS/CPR, first aid, infection control, emergency preparedness, documentation updates) and employer-specific trainings. 1 contact hour = 50 min; 1 semester credit = 15, 1 quarter credit = 10 contact hours.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Not required for the first renewal of a license granted by examination.
rules.carryover: Not allowed; credits may not be prorated over more than one renewal cycle.
rules.audit_note: The Board may require proof of completion (17 DCMR §6306.4) and conducts CE audits (§6315).

topics.who: LGBTQ cultural competency (since the term starting Oct 1, 2017)
10% of the required CE in DC Health public health priority topics (notice effective Oct 1, 2025)

rules.notes: Hours must be earned in the 2 years before the license expires. DC Health is moving all licenses to birth-month expiry (odd/even year matching birth year); during the one-time transition, licensees with less than 2 years on their term may submit 50% of CE, but the 2 LGBTQ hours and the 10% public health hours remain due. Military: CE can be completed within 6 months after discharge.
